annotations.title: Get a Go Rocket checkout link

description: Returns a checkout link when credits are needed. plan 'video' (default) buys ONE video of this site, the cheapest door; plan 'subscription' is the monthly plan. quality 'standard' (default, 1 credit) or 'cinema' (our most lifelike motion, 2 credits). Signed in, a one-time top-up for an existing subscriber. Existing account? Call sign_in, then create_video to use its credits first. For a new account, call this once the sample is ready. No money is charged by this tool: payment happens only after opening the checkout and confirming payment. After payment, sign in through this connector to create videos in the same chat.

inputSchema.description: claim_token is required for a signed-out sample checkout.

plan.description: One video (default) or the monthly plan.

quality.description: Quality tier for a one-video checkout (default standard).

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get a Go Rocket checkout link
